rules: Every shell file is pinned by byte size and SHA-256 at build time and verified before the service worker installs; a mismatch keeps the previous version.
The map library is not precached, to keep the first offline download small; it is cached only after it has been used online. Offline, every record stays in the tables.
Live index and snapshots are network first. Any HTTP response is the server's current answer; only a network failure or timeout falls back to a stored copy.
A stored live copy is kept only if the network copy was verified against the index reference, and is re-verified before every offline use.
Offline copies are always labelled LAST KNOWN with the time they were saved on this device; they are never shown as freshly checked.
Source freshness is still recomputed from preserved source, fetch and workflow timestamps, so an expired copy is shown as STALE.
Stored live copies older than the retention limit are deleted and never served.
Caches are versioned; an upgrade activates only after the user chooses to reload, and old caches are deleted on activation.

en.offline_banner: You are offline. Pages and live conditions shown are the last known copies saved on this device; nothing has been rechecked.
en.last_known_notice: LAST KNOWN — saved on this device {time}. Not rechecked; this is not a current check.
en.last_known_feed: LAST KNOWN copy saved {time}; not rechecked.
en.update_ready: An updated version of the atlas is ready.
